resources.string: Lock Messages stays unlocked while you browse messages and conversations. With Lock again when you leave on, it locks again after you leave Messages. Chosen chats lock again after you leave that conversation.
Open your Direct inbox first to load available chats, then return here.
Enter passcode to change chat locks
Enter passcode to view hidden chats
Set a passcode in InstaEclipse Lock settings first.
Enter passcode to open this chat
Hidden chats are unavailable for this inbox.
Remove the passcode? All locks turn off. Your locked-chat and collection lists and hidden chats are kept.
Enter your passcode to change lock settings
No passcode yet. Turning on a lock asks you to choose one.
Some locks are on, but no passcode is set, so nothing is locked yet. Set a passcode or turn the locks off.
To see hidden chats, triple-tap your name at the top left of Messages and enter your passcode.
Set a passcode to open hidden chats
Confirm with your phone\'s screen lock. Your InstaEclipse passcode and all locks are removed; your chat and collection lock lists and hidden chats are kept.
Passcode recovery needs Android 11 or newer.
Set a screen lock in Android settings, then try again.

Clearing Instagram\'s data also removes this lock, but it signs you out and deletes what InstaEclipse keeps inside Instagram (kept messages, cached stories, edit history, chat lists). If you can still open the InstaEclipse menu, back up data first.
Your InstaEclipse passcode is gone and every lock is off. Your locked chat and collection lists and hidden chats are kept, so you can turn the locks back on whenever you like.
A locked collection opens with your InstaEclipse passcode. Set one to lock this collection.
Saved > All posts and collection covers stay visible.
